mapper.select: SELECT /* getFileByNumb */ FILE_NUMB , ORIG_NAME , STOR_NAME , FILE_PATH , FILE_SIZE , MIME_TYPE , REGI_USER , REGI_DATE FROM TM_FILEXM WHERE FILE_NUMB = #{fileNumb}
SELECT /* getFileListByRegiUser */ FILE_NUMB , ORIG_NAME , STOR_NAME , FILE_PATH , FILE_SIZE , MIME_TYPE , REGI_USER , REGI_DATE FROM TM_FILEXM WHERE REGI_USER = #{regiUser} ORDER BY FILE_NUMB
